The development offers a refined selection of studios and one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to suit both homeowners and investors. Strategically located with excellent connectivity to Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, DIFC, and Dubai International Airport, Meydan offers both lifestyle appeal and strong investment potential. description: Binghatti Spectre is a mixed-use development by Binghatti, presented under the concept "A Presence Beyond the Visible." The project comprises two towers of contrasting heights rising above a shared podium base, with a sculptural, fluid silhouette. Residence formats include studios, apartments, and Royal Suites in one-, two-, and three-bedroom configurations, alongside dedicated office and retail space. The development is positioned as a contemporary residential and commercial destination, complemented by panoramic city views. Residents have access to a dedicated pool for adults and children, together with a yoga and aerobics platform and a paddle and tennis court for active pursuits. A children's play area sits alongside family sitting and social nooks, while wellness facilities and lounge sitting platforms provide space for relaxation. The development also includes an open lawn, a dedicated jogging and sprint lane, and activity tables with a ping-pong table for recreation. Interior layouts range from efficient studios to expansive three-bedroom residences, with the largest configurations featuring a private pool and a terrace open to the sky, plus dedicated laundry space. Rooms are organized around distinct living, dining, and kitchen zones, with master suites in the larger units. The residences feature modern finishing with high-quality materials throughout, and are delivered unfurnished. Location description and benefits Al Jaddaf is a vibrant and rapidly developing neighborhood located on the banks of Dubai Creek. Known for its strategic location, Al Jaddaf is situated between Dubai's old town and the bustling modern hubs of Downtown Dubai and Business Bay. This unique positioning makes it a desirable area for both residents and businesses, offering seamless connectivity to key parts of the city via major highways like Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, as well as easy access to public transport, including the Dubai Metro and Creek ferry services. Its proximity to Dubai International Airport further enhances its appeal as a convenient and well-connected neighborhood. The area is a blend of tradition and modernity, reflecting Dubai's rich cultural heritage while embracing contemporary urban development. Al Jaddaf is home to the iconic Dubai Frame, a major landmark that offers breathtaking views of the city, and the historical Dubai Creek, which retains its charm as a hub of the city's maritime and trade history. The area also features the Jameel Arts Centre, a cultural hotspot showcasing contemporary art and fostering creative expression, making Al Jaddaf an attractive destination for art and culture enthusiasts. Al Jaddaf offers a well-rounded lifestyle with a growing array of residential, commercial, and leisure options. It features a variety of modern apartment complexes, many of which boast waterfront views and state-of-the-art amenities. The neighborhood's emphasis on green spaces, including the landscaped walkways along the creek, promotes outdoor activities and a healthy lifestyle. With upcoming developments and a focus on enhancing community living, Al Jaddaf continues to grow as one of Dubai's most promising and sought-after residential and cultural hubs.

description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

title: Dubayy, Dubai
description: Reference: YHKN-T13221. Eywa is an exclusive luxury residential development located along the Dubai Canal in the prestigious district of Business Bay. Inspired by the symbolism of the Tree of Life, the project combines high end architecture with a lifestyle concept focused on wellness, balance, and connection with nature. The building offers a limited collection of just 50 waterfront residences and two ultra luxury penthouses. Apartments range from spacious two to five bedroom layouts, with living areas from approximately 3,064 to over 16,000 square feet. Each residence is designed to maximize natural light and views, featuring expansive terraces, floor to ceiling windows, and natural elements that create a calm and harmonious living environment. The architecture draws inspiration from the organic structure of a banyan tree, with flowing forms and natural materials that give the building its distinctive appearance. Many residences include private pools, waterfalls, and lush greenery, creating a unique indoor outdoor living experience rarely found in city developments. A key element of the project is its focus on holistic well being. Residents have access to a wide range of wellness focused facilities including a luxury spa, yoga and meditation spaces, fitness studio, crystal gardens, and relaxation areas. A distinctive feature of the building is a crystal pyramid integrated within the structure, incorporating thousands of semi precious stones intended to promote positive energy and balance throughout the space. Eywa is also designed with sustainability and health conscious living in mind. The project aims to achieve both LEED Platinum and WELL Platinum certifications, reflecting high standards in energy efficiency, environmental responsibility, and indoor air and water quality. Natural materials such as wood, stone, and clay are used extensively to create warm, natural interiors while reducing environmental impact. Residents benefit from a wide selection of premium amenities including swimming pools, a wellness spa with hammam and sauna, beauty salon, cinema lounge, library, clubhouse dining spaces, and children's activity areas. Additional lifestyle services provide concierge assistance, wellness programs, housekeeping, and other tailored services designed to enhance everyday living. Situated along the scenic Dubai Canal and just minutes from iconic landmarks such as Dubai Fountain, the development offers a peaceful waterfront setting while remaining close to Dubai's major business, shopping, and entertainment destinations. Combining innovative architecture, sustainability, and a wellness driven lifestyle concept, Eywa represents a new standard of luxury living in Dubai where modern comfort meets harmony with nature. description: Exclusive Waterfront Apartments with Wynn Casino Views in Ras Al Khaimah Ras Al Khaimah, the northernmost emirate of the UAE, is renowned for its stunning coastline, majestic mountains, and rapidly growing luxury real estate market. This dynamic destination blends rich cultural heritage with modern infrastructure, offering residents and investors a high-quality lifestyle. One of the most anticipated developments in the region is the Wynn Al Marjan Island, the UAE's first integrated gaming and resort destination. Set to open in 2027, this mega-project will feature a world-class casino, luxury hotels, fine dining, and entertainment experiences, making Ras Al Khaimah a premier global tourism and investment hub. With its breathtaking waterfront views, expanding infrastructure, and promising economic growth, Ras Al Khaimah is quickly becoming one of the most sought-after locations in the UAE for luxury living and investment opportunities. are conveniently located just 3 minutes from Al Hamra Mall, 6 minutes from Al Marjan Island Beach and Al Hamra Marina & Yacht Club, 13 minutes from Ras Al Khaimah Corniche, 15 minutes from Wynn Casino, 25 minutes from Ras Al Khaimah International Airport, 45 minutes from Dubai International Airport, and 55 minutes from Downtown Dubai. Designed as an exclusive waterfront community, this development seamlessly blends modern luxury with natural tranquility. It features five elegant 18-story towers, each offering breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf and the iconic Wynn Al Marjan Island. Inspired by traditional Arabic architecture, the exteriors combine earthy tones and contemporary design, creating a visually striking yet serene environment. Residents can enjoy direct sea access and an extensive array of world-class amenities, including a scenic promenade, state-of-the-art fitness center, coworking spaces, an entertainment room, multiple swimming pools, a kids' play area, jogging tracks, and championship padel tennis courts. For outdoor enthusiasts, lush parks, a dedicated pet-friendly zone with grooming services, and barbecue areas enhance the community's appeal. The development is further enriched by its proximity to the Royal Yacht Club, Al Hamra Golf Club, and an array of luxury hotels, fine dining, and high-end retail outlets, ensuring a sophisticated yet relaxed lifestyle. The project offers a meticulously designed collection of residences, including spacious 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, each crafted for modern comfort and elegance. Interiors are thoughtfully planned with open layouts that maximize natural light, featuring floor-to-ceiling windows that frame stunning sea views. High-quality finishes and premium materials create a sophisticated ambiance, complemented by neutral, earthy tones inspired by the surrounding landscape. Each residence is equipped with fitted wardrobes, ensuring ample storage space, and a fully integrated kitchen with high-end white goods, blending convenience with contemporary aesthetics. The living and dining areas flow seamlessly onto private balconies, offering breathtaking vistas of the Arabian Gulf. The master bedrooms are designed as serene retreats, with en-suite bathrooms featuring sleek fixtures and refined detailing. Smart home technology and energy-efficient features enhance everyday living, while spacious layouts cater to both relaxation and entertainment, creating an unparalleled waterfront lifestyle. description:
Ocean Star is a residential development by Emaar Properties, located within Rashid Yachts & Marina at Mina Rashid, Dubai. The project comprises two residential buildings offering a selection of one, two and three-bedroom apartments, combining contemporary interiors with a waterfront setting and access to the wider marina community.

Three-bedroom apartments feature larger interiors and, in selected layouts, substantially larger balconies or terraces. Ocean Star is designed around a waterfront lifestyle, with a signature canal pool, landscaped green spaces and recreational facilities. Residents can enjoy access to a gym, recreational courts, a community park and a boardwalk promenade. The surrounding community also provides access to marina facilities, retail and dining options, and nearby educational and healthcare facilities.
Located within Rashid Yachts & Marina, Ocean Star offers access to the waterfront promenade and the wider marina environment. Dubai International Airport is approximately 15 minutes away by car, while Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are around 20 minutes away. With its range of apartment sizes, waterfront setting and community facilities, Ocean Star offers an appealing option for end-users, families and investors seeking a home in Dubai's marina district.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

title: 78Q2+2Q, Dubai
description: The Arabian Gulf does not offer this view to everyone. At Samana Ocean Crest, it comes with your morning coffee. Fifty-six residences. One island. No compromise. Developed by Samana Developers - ranked fifth among Dubai's highest off-plan sellers by volume in the first half of 2025, with a portfolio valued at over AED 17 billion - Ocean Crest represents the developer's most considered coastal statement to date. Positioned on Dubai Islands, the Nakheel-masterplanned destination that redefines what island living means in this city, the project rises across eight residential floors with a discipline of scale that most developers would not allow themselves: just 56 residences, each one crafted with the attention that only boutique numbers permit. Many homes feature private terrace pools, interiors finished in warm natural stone, wood, and glass, and layouts calibrated around panoramic sea and skyline perspectives. Samana has built its reputation on delivering resort-style living as a lived experience rather than a marketing promise - and Ocean Crest is where that philosophy meets the Gulf itself. THE EXPERIENCE: Life at Ocean Crest operates at the cadence of the sea. Mornings open to the Arabian Gulf with no obstruction, afternoons unfold across a resort-grade amenity landscape, and evenings carry the particular stillness that only island addresses can offer. This is not urban living softened by a view. It is coastal living, fully committed. Private terrace pools - select residences with direct pool access from your own outdoor space Infinity pool and sun deck - a skyline-facing water environment designed for unhurried days Yoga studios and wellness spaces - dedicated areas for restoration alongside the water's edge Spa, sauna, and steam rooms - a full wellness facility integrated into the building's daily rhythm Children's splash pad and family zones - thoughtfully separated spaces for every generation Landscaped gardens and jogging tracks - green corridors woven into the island environment 24/7 concierge and artistic lobby - a resident arrival experience that sets the register from the first step THE INVESTMENT CASE: Dubai Islands is one of the few remaining large-scale waterfront destinations in Dubai where early capital allocation still carries meaningful upside - a Nakheel-developed master community with confirmed infrastructure, beach access, and a pipeline of hospitality and retail that will anchor long-term demand. Ocean Crest's boutique scale of 56 residences operates as a natural scarcity lever in a market where oversupply is the persistent structural risk. Samana's 86% foreign investor demand ratio confirms the international conviction behind the developer's product - and a freehold title on a beachfront island address, at a confirmed entry point of AED 2.2M, positions this well within reach of the buyer profile that this location will continue to attract. With handover in Q3 2028 and a 20/70/10 payment plan, the capital deployment is structured to carry investors through the community's most active development phase. WHO THIS IS FOR: This is for those who have spent enough time in landlocked buildings and have decided, with some finality, that the water is non-negotiable. People who want their Dubai address to signal something more specific than premium - something coastal, considered, and genuinely rare at this scale. Buyers who understand the arithmetic of boutique beachfront freehold on an emerging island master plan, and who also simply want to swim in their own pool on a Tuesday morning with nothing but the Gulf in front of them. Ocean Crest. Fifty-six chances to own the edge of the island.

The payment plan is structured as 35/65 , with 5% payable on booking, 30% during construction and the remaining 65% on handover. A key advantage of Holm Central is the combination of a spacious 2-bedroom layout with a staff room, extensive shared amenities and a central Jumeirah Garden City location. description: This is not a two-bedroom apartment with a generous balcony. It is a 3,302.26 sq ft (306.79 m²) private-pool residence whose outdoor space is larger than its entire interior. Set on the seventh floor of Aqua Arc, the corner plan combines sea and internal-landscape views with a remarkable 2,099.39 sq ft private terrace and an asking price of AED 8,558,998. The pool belongs to the residence and occupies the outer arc of the terrace. It is not several floors away within a shared amenity deck. That single distinction changes how the home can be used: the outdoor space becomes a private setting for quiet mornings, open-air dining and evenings hosted above Al Marjan Island. Inside, the 1,202.87 sq ft (111.75 m²) suite is planned as a complete two-bedroom home. The entrance creates a clear transition into the living areas, with a 2.0 by 2.5 metre kitchen connecting naturally to the 4.6 by 5.2 metre living and dining room. The curved frontage draws the eye toward the terrace, allowing the interior to remain visually connected with the pool and the changing outlook beyond it. The private accommodation sits away from the main social space. The principal bedroom measures 3.8 by 4.2 metres and is paired with a substantial 2.8 by 3.6 metre bathroom. The second bedroom measures 3.3 by 4.2 metres and is served by another full bathroom. A separate powder room keeps guest use away from the bedroom accommodation, while a dedicated laundry preserves the kitchen as part of the home's entertaining space. The terrace is the defining room. At approximately 195.04 m², it offers enough breadth to compose several outdoor zones instead of forcing every activity into one arrangement. There is scope for dining near the living room, a more relaxed lounge along the curved frontage and sun loungers beside the private pool. These are potential uses rather than included furnishings, but the physical proportions make each possible without compromising circulation. The seventh-floor corner position gives the residence two distinct outlooks. One aspect turns toward the sea; the other takes in Aqua Arc's internal landscape. The view therefore develops as one moves around the terrace rather than presenting a single fixed elevation. Together with the pool and the sweep of the architecture, that dual aspect gives the apartment a sense of privacy and occasion normally associated with a resort home. Aqua Arc's design is shaped by flowing façades, wave-inspired balconies and a restrained coastal palette. The interior concepts combine pale stone, warm timber and soft neutral tones, allowing the water and natural light to remain central to the experience. Project visuals show the intended design language; final materials, fixtures, appliances and furniture must follow the executed sale documents. The planned amenity programme includes indoor and outdoor fitness areas, walking trails, recreational lawns, barbecue facilities, a pool bar, steam and sauna facilities, and indoor and outdoor children's play areas. Beach access is also identified in the project material. Final access rights, operating arrangements and completion specifications remain subject to the governing documents. description: Altus by Emaar is a contemporary residential development designed to bring together modern elegance, urban convenience, and sustainable living. Featuring thoughtfully designed residences and a distinctive architectural style, the development offers a refined lifestyle complemented by expansive views and well-planned living spaces. description: Beachfront Apartments with Installments on Siniyah Island, Umm Al-Quwain Siniyah Island in Umm Al-Quwain is a stunning haven that blends luxurious living with breathtaking natural surroundings. This exclusive community offers a range of upscale residences, including waterfront villas and elegant apartments, thoughtfully crafted for a sophisticated island lifestyle. Residents benefit from direct beach access, expansive green spaces, and world-class amenities such as an 18-hole golf course, eco-park, and water sports adventures. With its rich ecological diversity and cultural heritage, Siniyah Island provides a peaceful escape just 50 minutes from Dubai, perfectly balancing tranquility and urban convenience. Umm Al Quwain are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project offers a luxurious lifestyle harmoniously integrated with natural beauty, featuring state-of-the-art residential units within multi-use towers ranging from 2 to 10 stories. The development is surrounded by pristine white sand beaches, lush mangroves, and a rich tapestry of unique wildlife. Community amenities include a recreational fishing deck, family-oriented golf course, event cabanas, al fresco dining, and luxury beach cabanas. A seawater lagoon is central to the community, providing facilities for non-motorized water sports such as snorkeling, paddleboarding, kayaking, and floating cinema experiences. Linear parks are equipped with yoga decks, wellness parks, and sports facilities like tennis and paddle courts, alongside skateboarding zones. Additional highlights include a yacht club, mosque, retail mall, public beach, and helicopter landing pad. Residents can enjoy a clubhouse with a gym, library lounge, steam and sauna rooms, and multipurpose spaces. The development also prioritizes sustainability with double-glazed façades, energy-efficient systems, and provisions for electric vehicle charging. The project features meticulously designed interiors that combine elegance with functionality, offering 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments with spacious layouts and high-quality finishes. Each unit is equipped with fitted wardrobes and kitchens that include premium white goods such as an oven, gas hob and hood, refrigerator, and washing machine. The living and bedroom areas are adorned with porcelain tile flooring and finished with matte emulsion paint walls for a sleek yet cozy ambiance. The master bedrooms boast en-suite bathrooms, while all bathrooms and powder rooms are outfitted with premium-brand water closets, washbasins, and chrome-plated fittings. Kitchens feature high-quality reconstituted stone countertops and laminate or high-gloss PET-finished cabinets. The design emphasizes luxury and practicality, with concealed cisterns in bathrooms and carefully selected finishes throughout to enhance the overall living experience. UAQ-00004

The building is located in the heart of Downtown Dubai, in one of the city's most prestigious locations, close to urban landmarks and with easy access to major thoroughfares and business, retail and leisure centres. The architecture is distinguished by its imposing silhouette, with a glazed façade and modern lines, creating a striking presence in the urban skyline and offering privileged visual amplitudes, with floor-to-ceiling windows that maximise the entry of natural light and frame spectacular views of the city. The residential typologies available range from studios to three-bedroom apartments, also encompassing 1 and 2-bedroom apartments all designed with contemporary layouts, refined finishes and high standards of comfort. In addition to traditional residences, some premium units include special features such as jacuzzis, lap pools, balconies/terraces and large windows that provide direct views of the urban skyline or canal/water areas of the city. The set of amenities and services complements the notion of a luxury residence: residents will have access to an infinity pool at the top, a modern gym with city views, wellness and spa areas, elevated green areas (hanging gardens or 'sky gardens'), living spaces, children's areas, secure parking, concierge service, 24/7 security and controlled access. title: Business Bay, Dubai
description: Project general facts DWTN Residences is a landmark residential development that redefines vertical living through a unique concept of six dedicated lifestyle ecosystems integrated throughout the tower. The project comprises a limited collection of 432 exclusive residences and 90 signature residences, including one- to three-bedroom apartments, duplexes, penthouses, and an ultra-exclusive royal palace. The architectural concept transforms a traditional residential tower into a self-contained vertical community, where each ecosystem is designed to support different aspects of daily life. Particular attention has been given to spatial planning, natural light, and the seamless flow between living spaces, creating residences that combine functionality with contemporary sophistication. The development offers more than 75,000 square feet of amenities distributed across multiple levels of the tower. These lifestyle ecosystems are designed to support wellness, recreation, social interaction, business activities, relaxation, and entertainment. Residents benefit from a comprehensive range of facilities that create dedicated environments for fitness, leisure, community engagement, professional needs, and private celebrations, providing a complete residential experience within a single development. The residences feature premium materials and carefully executed interior finishes throughout. The design palette incorporates warm neutral tones, accents inspired by Gulf waters, and refined metallic details that contribute to a contemporary aesthetic. Kitchens are fully equipped with built-in appliances. Residences are delivered without furniture. The overall specification reflects modern finishing with high-quality materials and a strong emphasis on craftsmanship, comfort, and visual refinement. Location description and benefits Business Bay is one of Dubai's most dynamic and fast-paced neighborhoods, known as the city's central business, commercial, and residential hub. Located just minutes from Downtown Dubai and the iconic Burj Khalifa, it offers a strategic location with seamless access to Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road. Business Bay is a prime destination for professionals, entrepreneurs, and investors looking to be at the heart of Dubai's thriving economy, with a skyline defined by high-rise towers, luxury hotels, and modern office spaces. Beyond its corporate appeal, Business Bay has evolved into a vibrant lifestyle destination. The area features a wide range of residential options, from upscale studios to spacious penthouses, many with stunning views of the Dubai Canal. Residents enjoy an urban lifestyle with access to fine dining, boutique cafes, waterfront promenades, gyms, and art spaces, all set against a backdrop of architectural elegance. The Dubai Water Canal also adds a touch of serenity, perfect for walks, boat rides, or simply enjoying the city lights by the water. As one of the most well-connected and sought-after areas in Dubai, Business Bay continues to grow as a leading hub for luxury living and commercial innovation. Whether you're working, living, or investing, it offers the perfect blend of modern convenience, cosmopolitan energy, and high-end urban living - all in one prime location.

title: Dubayy, Dubai
description: Reference: YHKN-T13217. Eywa is an exclusive luxury residential development located along the Dubai Canal in the prestigious district of Business Bay. Inspired by the symbolism of the Tree of Life, the project combines high end architecture with a lifestyle concept focused on wellness, balance, and connection with nature. The building offers a limited collection of just 50 waterfront residences and two ultra luxury penthouses. Apartments range from spacious two to five bedroom layouts, with living areas from approximately 3,064 to over 16,000 square feet. Each residence is designed to maximize natural light and views, featuring expansive terraces, floor to ceiling windows, and natural elements that create a calm and harmonious living environment. The architecture draws inspiration from the organic structure of a banyan tree, with flowing forms and natural materials that give the building its distinctive appearance. Many residences include private pools, waterfalls, and lush greenery, creating a unique indoor outdoor living experience rarely found in city developments. A key element of the project is its focus on holistic well being. Residents have access to a wide range of wellness focused facilities including a luxury spa, yoga and meditation spaces, fitness studio, crystal gardens, and relaxation areas. A distinctive feature of the building is a crystal pyramid integrated within the structure, incorporating thousands of semi precious stones intended to promote positive energy and balance throughout the space. Eywa is also designed with sustainability and health conscious living in mind. The project aims to achieve both LEED Platinum and WELL Platinum certifications, reflecting high standards in energy efficiency, environmental responsibility, and indoor air and water quality. Natural materials such as wood, stone, and clay are used extensively to create warm, natural interiors while reducing environmental impact. Residents benefit from a wide selection of premium amenities including swimming pools, a wellness spa with hammam and sauna, beauty salon, cinema lounge, library, clubhouse dining spaces, and children's activity areas. Additional lifestyle services provide concierge assistance, wellness programs, housekeeping, and other tailored services designed to enhance everyday living. Situated along the scenic Dubai Canal and just minutes from iconic landmarks such as Dubai Fountain, the development offers a peaceful waterfront setting while remaining close to Dubai's major business, shopping, and entertainment destinations. Combining innovative architecture, sustainability, and a wellness driven lifestyle concept, Eywa represents a new standard of luxury living in Dubai where modern comfort meets harmony with nature. This district is well-suited for professionals in industrial sectors who wish to stay close to their workplace while maintaining a comfortable lifestyle. With affordable housing, a calm environment, and strong transport connectivity, Dubai Industrial City appeals to both individuals and families. description: Apartments in Opus with World Famous Design in Dubai Business Bay The ultra-luxury apartments are located in Opus in Dubai Business Bay. The centrally located Opus stands out with its spectacular design and is in the middle of Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall. This architectural wonder not only attracts attention with its unique design but also serves as a vibrant cultural and artistic center. It is a popular nightlife destination offering a variety of dining options. The are within a 5-minute walk from major attractions such as Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa, Dubai Opera, Business Bay, and Dubai Water Canal. Opus is designed as two separate towers that coalesce into a single whole, taking the shape of a cube. The cube is then ''carved'' to create a central void within the building, which is an important volume in its own right and provides a view from the center of the building to the exterior. The two towers are linked by a four-story atrium at ground level with a bridge connecting 71 meters above the ground. The bridge is constructed with double-curved glass, double-curved aluminum frames, and steel elements. The bridge consists of three storeys offering spectacular views and the feeling of being at the top. The 96 units in Opus are available in a range of sizes, from one and two-bedroom apartments to exceptional duplexes and triplexes. They all have full access to hotel facilities and spectacular amenities. On your doorstep, you will find an eclectic variety of innovative food and beverage experiences, cultural events, and artistic performances. The project offers luxury services such as 24/7 security and valet services, secured basement parking, valet parking service for visitors, house cleaning service, laundry services, special discounts on food, beverage, and entertainment facilities, and in-home catering. description: This is the FashionTV Acacia two-bedroom to look at when the view matters. Positioned on the 10th floor, the residence faces the sea and pool and offers 143.19 m² of total space, including two broad balconies. The Type E plan separates 108.22 m² of interior living from 34.97 m² of outdoor space. A 5.5-by-7.6-metre living and dining room forms the centre of the home, while the kitchen remains clearly defined without being cut off from the main entertaining area. Both bedrooms are generously proportioned, with two full bathrooms, a guest powder room, dressing space and a dedicated store. The two balconies extend along the curved façade, creating separate outdoor zones rather than a token terrace. Combined with the upper-floor position and published sea-and-pool outlook, they give this residence a clear lifestyle advantage within the two-bedroom collection. FashionTV Acacia brings a distinctive design identity to Al Marjan Island. BNW Developments is delivering the project, with architecture by Conin International. The published interiors favour warm timber, quiet stone tones and layered lighting; all visuals remain illustrative, while final finishes, fixtures and any furnishing package must follow the signed sale documents. The planned amenity programme includes an infinity pool, children's pool and play areas, landscaped gardens, a viewing deck, water features, a gymnasium, barbecue and fire-pit areas, family lounges, a café and signature restaurant spaces. Offered at AED 4,929,876, the residence follows the published 50/50 payment plan: 10% on booking, eight instalments of 5% through month 20, and the final 50% on completion. Expected handover is Q2 2028. Al Marjan Island places the residence within Ras Al Khaimah's established coastal and resort corridor. Published project information places Al Marjan Boulevard about six minutes away, Wynn Al Marjan Island about seven minutes away and Al Hamra Mall about eleven minutes away. Drive times are indicative. Contact Bhavesh Koonja, REALTOR and Certified International Property Specialist, at Tropical Riviera International Realty for the latest availability confirmation, exact floor plan, payment schedule, contractual specifications and reservation documents. The total areas of the units vary between about 724.65m² and 799m², including balconies and outdoor storage spaces. Units 6002 and 6102, also with five bedrooms, offer a similar configuration, with subtle differences in the size of the main rooms and leisure spaces, preserving the same level of finish and comfort characteristic of the development. On level 62 is a six-bedroom penthouse with 360-degree views over the entire city. This unit features two master suites with walk-in closet and spa-type bathrooms, cinema room, gym, sauna, hammam, wine room, bar, several living and dining rooms, three separate kitchens, private office, safe room, additional bedrooms with private bathrooms, full service area and multiple storage spaces. With more than 1840m² in total, it represents one of the most imposing and exclusive units of the development. On level 63 is another six-bedroom penthouse, with a similar but even wider layout, with total areas exceeding 1840m². This unit also enjoys completely unobstructed views, multiple social environments, spacious suites, technical and service areas, as well as generous outdoor spaces, designed to provide privacy, comfort and elegance. The finishes present in all units reflect the high standard of the development. The bathrooms include smart toilets and equipment from well-known brands, with premium finish furniture. The kitchens are fully equipped with high-performance appliances, cabinetry in durable materials and double sink. The development also offers several exclusive amenities, such as private outdoor cabanas, Bbq areas, outdoor living areas, leisure spaces and wellness environments integrated into carefully designed green areas. The development redefines the concept of seaside living in Dubai Harbour, combining spaciousness, privacy, excellent finishes and extraordinary views, offering a residential experience of true distinction both in the luxury penthouses and in this T1 overlooking the Marina, ideal for those looking for comfort, exclusivity and practicality. title: Damac Chic Tower
description:
Chic Tower is a DAMAC development in Business Bay, set on the Dubai Canal. The tower rises from a ground floor and five podium levels through 36 residential floors to a stepped roof, with undulating terraces that take their shape from the canal's waves. Its turquoise theme reflects the aesthetic of jeweller de GRISOGONO. The building holds around 450 homes: studios from 411 sq ft, one-bedroom apartments from 610 sq ft, two-bedroom apartments from 1,145 sq ft and a handful of three- and four-bedroom residences starting at 4,998 sq ft.

Homes are delivered unfurnished with fully equipped kitchens. The three- and four-bedroom units each have a planted terrace with an infinity pool, a personal gym and a projection screen. Wellness shapes the shared spaces: the lobby has workout benches and weights, and the podium holds seven baths, including hot, cold, salt and mud baths, a spa, a beauty bar and an outdoor calisthenics gym. Pools, cabanas, a juice bar, playgrounds, football pitches, party areas and a 180-metre lazy river complete it. Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Mall and DIFC are close by, and Dubai International Airport is about a 15-minute drive.

Business Bay and Burj Khalifa/Dubai Mall metro stations are both nearby. The tower includes just three three-bedroom homes and one four-bedroom home. DAMAC, active in the region since 2002, reported around 42,000 homes delivered as of December 2021. The payment plan is 20% on booking, 20% during construction and 60% on handover, which is expected in Q4 2026. The project is registered with the Dubai Land Department, with its escrow account held at Mashreq Bank.

title: Dubayy, Dubai
description: Reference: YHKN-T13214. Eywa Way of Water introduces an extraordinary vision of luxury waterfront living in Business Bay, set along the iconic Dubai Water Canal on prestigious Marasi Drive. Located just minutes from Burj Khalifa and the vibrant lifestyle of Downtown Dubai, this landmark development offers a unique blend of architectural beauty, wellness innovation, and sustainable design. Inspired by the movement and energy of water, Eywa Way of Water features striking organic architecture that reflects the harmony between nature and modern living. Sculptural elements and marine inspired motifs create a visual experience that connects residents with the calm and restorative power of the ocean. The development offers only 65 exclusive residences, including spacious two, three, and four bedroom apartments, three luxury duplexes, and an exceptional penthouse. Each residence is designed with privacy and comfort in mind, featuring private elevator lobbies, expansive layouts, and high end finishes crafted from sustainable and non toxic materials. Kitchens are equipped with premium appliances from Miele, Liebherr, and Bosch, while interiors incorporate natural stone, fine marble, and elegant wood finishes. Eywa Way of Water is designed as a holistic living ecosystem with a dedicated wellness environment offering more than 45 wellness experiences. Residents can enjoy multiple swimming pools, landscaped gardens, meditation spaces, a fitness and wellness studio, luxury spa facilities, and tranquil lounges designed for relaxation and social gatherings. The exclusive Sky Lounge level provides spectacular panoramic views across the canal and the Dubai skyline. The building integrates advanced technologies to support health and comfort, including MERV 14 air filtration with ionization, innovative water activation systems, smart home technology, and integrated EMF protection within residences to create a healthier indoor environment. Designed to meet the highest global standards, the project targets LEED Platinum certification for sustainability, WELL Platinum for health and well being, and WiredScore Platinum for advanced digital connectivity. Eywa Way of Water represents a new generation of luxury residences in Dubai where architecture, wellness, and waterfront living come together to create a truly elevated lifestyle. title: Union Takaya
description:
Takaya is being developed by Union Properties beside Dubai Autodrome in Motor City, near Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road. It combines three towers: Takaya Tower rises 29 floors above ground, basement and podium levels, while Symphony and Harmony each have 19. Townhouses and villas sit around a shared podium, for a total of 744 apartments, 39 townhouses and five villas plus retail units. Apartments run from studios to four bedrooms, with one- to four-bedroom layouts of 831 sq ft to 2,339 sq ft, and the four-bedroom townhouses are set over three levels with a roof terrace.

Homes are handed over semi-furnished, with soft pastel interiors and kitchens fitted with Siemens appliances; many layouts add a maid's room and walk-in wardrobes. The 24 shared amenities include lap, recreational and children's pools, three gyms, two squash courts, a paddle tennis court, a golf simulator, a cinema room, co-working spaces, a children's day care and a sky garden. Parking is provided for 1,203 cars, 100 of them enabled for EV charging. A landscaped retail plaza sits at street level, and Motor City's gardens, cycle paths and the Dubai Outdoor Kartdrome are nearby.

Union Properties, founded in 1987 and publicly listed, is the developer behind Motor City, Dubai Autodrome and Uptown Mirdif, and has delivered more than 10,000 units in Dubai. Takaya adds a broad spread of apartment sizes and a limited number of townhouses and villas to this established community between major highways. The payment plan asks for 5% on booking and 15% during construction, with the remaining 80% due on handover, expected in Q4 2027.

The tower opens onto Gate Avenue at both ground and podium level, a Dubai Metro station is about five minutes on foot, Burj Khalifa and the Museum of the Future are around five minutes by car, and Dubai International Airport is roughly 20 minutes away.

DIFC is home to more than 46,000 professionals working across over 6,900 registered companies, so the homes sit close to a large and established workforce. The developer is the financial centre itself, and the building combines residences with offices and retail in a single address. Travel Hubs: Global connectivity is a breeze. Why Invest in Nama 3? The 1-bedroom units in Nama 3 are designed with the modern minimalist in mind, featuring open-plan layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows that invite natural light, and premium materials throughout. As Sharjah continues to grow as a cultural and economic powerhouse, properties within integrated communities like Al Mamsha Raseel are expected to see significant capital appreciation and high rental yields. description: We offer for sale a 2-room apartment with a rental contract, with an area of 88 m² , in the popular Zabeel area. The apartment is located in the new residential complex 1 Residences. It is fully renovated and equipped with furniture and appliances. The offered apartment is on a high floor, with a well-thought-out and convenient layout, a spacious balcony, and panoramic views of the park. The bright interior is designed in a modern style in cool tones with marble and tiles. The apartment has 1 parking space in the underground garage. Starting price - EUR 585,830. There is currently an annual rental contract with monthly payments. The current return is 5-6% per year. There is potential to increase profitability by renting the apartment short-term. About the project 1 Residences is a complex of two original towers in the shape of the number "1" in the historic district of Bur Dubai. The 43-storey buildings are elegantly connected at the top levels by a skybridge. Construction of the project was completed in 2022. Infrastructure On the podium level of the complex and the top three floors, public areas with landscaping and premium amenities have been created for residents and guests of 1 Residences. These include swimming pools with lounge areas, fountains, children's playgrounds, a modern gym, a 340-meter running track on the 43rd floor, and much more. The 1 Residences complex is located in Al Kifaf, near Dubai's popular historic district of Bur Dubai. The area includes many historic sites: the Dubai Museum in 18th-century style, the historic Al Bastakiya quarter, and more. The active residence of the Emir of Dubai, Zabeel Palace, is also located here. The district's special attractions include the grand viewing platform Dubai Frame and Zabeel Park. The park can be considered a huge green oasis. There you will find dinosaur sculptures, illuminated gardens, an ice park with children's rides, barbecue pavilions, and a running track with non-slip coating and aroma diffuser. All these locations are within a 5-10 minute drive from the complex. It takes five minutes by car to reach Dubai's main highway, Sheikh Zayed Road, which runs along the coast. This highway provides quick access to any location in Dubai, as well as to the neighboring emirates of Abu Dhabi and Sharjah. The apartments in 1 Residences appeal to lovers of luxury and active lifestyles who want to enjoy comfort in a modern residential complex with unique architecture. The strategic proximity to the center of Dubai, business districts, and the airport highlights the convenience of living in 1 Residences.

description: Shahrukhz Residences is a waterfront residential tower inspired by Shah Rukh Khan and built around the idea of living life king style.
